generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: A delivery certificate can become stale when material writes occur after the certified candidate has been frozen.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Treat a previously valid terminal certificate as permanently valid even after source, test, schema, configuration, or documentation changes move the material candidate.
trigger_signals: published result-only child no longer directly follows current material candidate
generalized_learning.prevention_rule: Any material write after certification invalidates the terminal handoff and requires exact-head gates plus a new freeze before republishing.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: Compare fresh remote head, certified material parent, and changed-path allowlist before accepting a terminal handoff.

transfer_cases.expected: certificate becomes stale and requires refreeze
terminal child must directly descend from current material candidate

skill_changes.evidence: Delivery terminal-handoff policy already mandates post-write refreeze and direct result-only publication.
Terminal validator already checks parent lineage, fresh remote identity, and allowlisted result paths.
